title: Abyssals v0.90.14 — Glass Scars and Stormcatch
notes: Detailed worn stone mountain steps and a broken supply-cart illustration replace the temporary drawings. Glass Scars now has vitrified lightning craters with safe route clearance and matching basin collision. Storm lightning has irregular branching leaders and thinner forks.
